research_question.text: 增益来自检索本身，还是来自更大的 reader？
research_question.quote: We ask how much of the gain comes from retrieval rather than from a larger reader.

data.text: 2018 年 Wikipedia dump，每题检索 20 个段落。
data.quote: We build an index over the 2018 Wikipedia dump

method.text: 12 层编码器 reader，训练 3 轮、批大小 32，检索模块冻结。
method.quote: The reader is a 12-layer encoder trained for 3 epochs with a batch size of 32.

findings.text: Natural Questions 上 exact match 达到 41.7，比闭卷基线高 4.2 点。
findings.quote: The retrieval-augmented reader reaches 41.7 exact match on Natural Questions

findings.text: 去掉检索会损失 9.1 点。

section_summaries.text: 摘要给出方法定位、4.2 点提升以及仅限英语的范围说明。
section_summaries.quote: The reader improves exact-match accuracy by 4.2 points over a closed-book baseline

section_summaries.text: 对比闭卷与检索式 reader，提出归因问题。
section_summaries.quote: Closed-book readers must store all evidence in their parameters.

section_summaries.text: 报告 41.7 EM、消融损失 9.1 点，并声明只评估英语。
section_summaries.quote: Ablations show that removing retrieval costs 9.1 points.

knowledge_points.text: 检索增强 reader 在 Natural Questions 上比闭卷基线高 4.2 点。
移除检索模块会造成 9.1 点损失，说明增益主要来自检索。
